reason: A $79 one-time lifetime deal with a 14-day refund is exactly how I buy tools, and the phone captures match how I check our site. I'd run the free 15 pages for a week first, and if the alerts aren't junk I'd grab the lifetime before the 100 spots go.
objection: Every change-alert tool I've tried pings me about rotating banners, carousels and timestamps until I mute it. On top of that, 25 pages per site doesn't cover our whole company site, and a brand-new startup with no reviews might not be around long enough for 'lifetime' to mean anything.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tier sends me even a few false 'changed' alerts in the first week, I won't buy. Same if the lifetime deal turned into a subscription.
